title.zh: 规定菲律宾前总统遗孀终身抚恤金的法案
title.en: An Act Providing a Life Pension for Widows of Ex-Presidents of the Philippines
title.orig: An Act Providing a Life Pension for Widows of Ex-Presidents of the Philippines

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1948/ra_208_1948.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The widow of an ex-President of the Philippines, or of a President who dies in office shall be entitled to a life pension of twelve thousand pesos per year payable to her monthly by the Treasury of the Philippines.

This Act shall take effect on April fifteen, nineteen hundred and forty-eight.
Approved: June 1, 1948.
